test_golden_message_serialization: test parsing and serializing a golden protobuf message with all field types set
test_pickle_protobuf_message: test pickling and unpickling a protobuf message to verify round-trip equality
test_sort_repeated_scalar_fields: test sorting repeated scalar fields like int32, float, and string with default comparator
test_sort_repeated_composite_fields: test sorting repeated composite message fields using a custom comparator or key function
test_parsing_merge_behavior: test that required and optional fields merge while repeated fields accumulate on parse
